adds.title: Mexico City Civil Code Amendments - Transgender birth certificate changes
adds.summary: As of March 12, 2026, legal gender recognition is possible in Mexico, with 22 of 32 states permitting individuals to update official documents without invasive medical or psychological evaluations.

adds.title: Mexico City Legislative Assembly law on transgender gender change
adds.summary: As of March 2026, Mexico permits legal gender recognition with 22 of 32 states allowing individuals to update official documents without invasive medical or psychological evaluations, federal and local laws prohibit conversion practices, and LGBTQ persons still experience discrimination and harassment in education and employment.
